# Studio stickman — Style Prompt

> A clean modern tech explainer: one friendly 2D stick figure in a smooth red beanie and a yellow t-shirt, black stick limbs and shorts, dot eyes, acting inside a bright white high-key studio whose floor is a faint light-grey perspective grid. The ideas float beside it as sleek glowing glass panels in cyan and electric blue; everything else is clean white space.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

A **launch-stage talk-clean studio with a cartoon host**: each shot is one physical interaction between the figure and the space or a glass panel (carrying a wobbling stack, bumping an invisible ceiling, tapping the floor to send a ripple, drawing a light bridge, touching a panel that unlocks). Text lives on the glass, short and big. It suits tech and tool tutorials, work and career tips, a class or a course, a shop explaining its system, a creator's method.

Not sci-fi (no circuit-board textures, wall panels, corridors, neon grime), not a dark UI demo, not a flat white explainer (the studio has a floor plane and depth), not a slideshow of cards: the figure always does something with its body.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Studio**: the background is near-white with a soft high-key light from above (a wide radial lift at the top centre, darker toward the corners by 5 % at most). The floor starts at 55 % of the height: a barely darker plane with a light-grey one-point perspective grid (lines ~2 px, converging to the centre; cross-lines spaced wider toward the viewer). A few large rounded wall blocks at the sides, almost invisible. Drawn once; it never moves.
- **Figure**: thin black stick limbs (8 px at 1080 high × 1.4 scale), a big round white head with a black outline and two dot eyes and a line mouth (smile, worried, "oh"), a smooth red beanie with a ribbed band and no pom-pom, a yellow t-shirt with short sleeves and a thin black outline, black shorts as two short thick strokes, round white mitten hands with an outline, small black shoes. About 3.5 heads tall, cute rather than lanky.
- **Glass UI**: rounded rectangles (radius 22 px) with a 16 % cyan tint, a 3 px light-cyan border, a soft outer glow and an inner glow drawn once, three dots at the top-left, light bars for placeholder text. Icons inside are solid cyan (a check circle, a lock). Floor tiles are glass parallelograms lying on the grid.
- **Light effects**: a glowing line is two strokes, a 7 px core and a 26 px halo at 25 %; ripples are thin cyan ellipses on the floor plane; impact flashes are a short glass bar plus five tick strokes.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the studio white; `--teks` is the line colour (limbs, outlines, titles); `--teks-redup` for labels on glass and the info line. A dark brand turns the studio into a dark one with light limbs: keep the glass bright.
- `--utama` is the beanie and the contact pill (the red of the character); `--pita` (the main colour mixed toward the ink) is its ribbed band. `--utama-di-latar` only for a rare red word.
- `--aksen` is the glass glow: tint (`--kaca`), border (`--kaca-garis`), halo (`--cahaya`), icons, ripples and light lines. `--aksen-di-latar` colours the key word or the ≠ in a title.
- `--kaus` (a fixed warm yellow) is the t-shirt and sleeves; it is the figure's identity and does not follow the brand.
- Rule: red only on the figure's head and the contact; cyan only for glass and light; the rest is white and ink.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries titles: a heavy grotesque in uppercase (Archivo Black by default; Poppins 800 or Inter 800 suit), 104 px at 1080 high, one line centred at the top, 2–4 words, one word or symbol in `--aksen-di-latar`. The closing name 88 px on two lines, left.
- On glass: one big figure in `--font-judul` (120 px), labels in `--font-isi` 600 at 32–34 px, a formula or code line in IBM Plex Mono 38 px.
- `--font-isi` (Inter 600/800) for the info line at 36 px and the contact pill at 40 px bold.
- No speech bubbles or dialogue boxes; words live on titles and glass.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Shot length** 2.4–3.6 s, hard cuts; each shot has a beginning, middle and end action (enter, interact, react), never an idle figure.
- **Acting**: pose-to-pose, 0.25–0.35 s `power2.inOut`; points and cheers `back.out(1.8–2)`; walk cycles 0.3 s per half `sine.inOut`; a carry wobble 0.32 s. The mouth changes at the moment of the hit.
- **Physical comedy**: crouch 0.25 s, leap 0.25 s `power2.out` up 150 px, bump (a 0.05 s flash, ticks pop with `back.out(2.4)`), fall back with `bounce.out` in 0.55 s.
- **Glass**: panels rise 40 px with a slight scale (0.92 → 1) in 0.45 s `back.out(1.6)`, or from the floor 220 px in 0.55 s; rows stagger 0.18 s; numbers count in 0.8 s `power2.out`; checks pop from 0.2 scale with `back.out(2.6)` every 0.3 s.
- **Light**: lines draw in 0.9 s `power2.inOut`; ripples scale ×14 and fade in 1.1 s, three of them 0.18 s apart.
- **Camera**: locked; a 1.03 linear push on the hook only. No whip pans, morphs or melting transformations.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked wide studio, figure + one panel | the idea, clean and calm | a tool; a method; a feature |
| Split stage, two versions of the figure | the contrast | busy vs done; manual vs automatic |
| Figure vs invisible ceiling | a limit you hit | time; skills; a plateau |
| Panel rising from the floor | a solution appears | a formula; a template; a setting |
| Light bridge over the floor | a path forward | a workflow; a shortcut; a next step |
| Settled hold on glass + contact | time to read and act | the class; the shop; the channel |

## 7. Native moves

- **The wobbling stack.** The figure staggers in carrying a tall stack of glass panels that sway, the top one slides off; its calm self points at one checked panel. *Fits content like:* busy ≠ done; too many apps; a seller juggling chats; a student with ten open tabs.
- **The glass ceiling.** Crouch, leap, bump an invisible ceiling with a cyan flash, bounce down and scratch the head, while a panel shows the number that hurts. *Fits content like:* 3 hours of manual recap; stuck at 1,000 followers; a salary plateau; a story's hero hitting a wall.
- **The floor ripple.** A sneaker tap sends cyan ripples across the grid and a glass panel rises from the floor with its rows filling in. *Fits content like:* one formula; a template that fills itself; a booking form; a teacher's grading sheet.
- **The light bridge.** A light pen draws a glowing curve; glass tiles appear on the floor and tick themselves as the figure walks across. *Fits content like:* stock that updates itself; a 4-step onboarding; a course roadmap; a delivery tracked to the door.
- **The unlock.** The figure touches a floating panel and the lock's shackle springs open, beside the name and a red contact pill. *Fits content like:* join the class; open the free template; book a consult; follow the channel.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Circuit textures, sci-fi wall panels, dark corridors, grunge or realistic lighting: the studio stays white and empty.
- Losing the beanie or the shirt, adding a pom-pom, detailed eyes or pupils: the figure must stay the same simple character in every shot.
- Glass without glow or with heavy blur filters: tint, border and a static glow carry it; never animate the glow or use backdrop blur.
- Speech bubbles or dialogue text boxes; long text on glass.
- An idle figure staring at the camera; abstract morphing or liquid transformations.
- Cyan used for body text on white: words on the studio use `--aksen-di-latar`, glass carries `--teks`.

# Studio stickman: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.4, medium 3, long 3.6.

## hook

- en: 'A ≠ B' title; the figure staggers under a wobbling stack of glass panels while its calm self points at one checked panel
- id: judul 'A ≠ B'; orang terhuyung membawa tumpukan panel kaca yang goyah, dirinya yang tenang menunjuk satu panel bercentang

## problem

- en: the figure leaps and bumps an invisible glass ceiling, a cyan flash, bounces down and scratches its head; a panel shows the pain
- id: orang melompat dan membentur plafon kaca tak terlihat, kilat cyan, memantul jatuh lalu menggaruk kepala; panel menunjukkan masalahnya

## fact

- en: one glowing glass panel floats up with a big number and a short label; the figure points at it, worried or pleased
- id: satu panel kaca menyala melayang naik dengan angka besar dan label pendek; orang menunjuknya, cemas atau senang

## step

- en: a sneaker tap sends cyan ripples across the floor grid, a glass panel rises from the floor and its rows fill in
- id: ketukan sepatu memancarkan riak cyan di kisi lantai, panel kaca naik dari lantai dan barisnya terisi

## compare

- en: split studio: left a cluttered glass stack, right one clean panel with a check; a cyan ≠ between two big words
- id: studio terbelah: kiri tumpukan kaca berantakan, kanan satu panel rapi bercentang; ≠ cyan di antara dua kata besar

## number

- en: a big number counts up on a floating glass panel, its bar fills in cyan; the figure cheers, arms up
- id: angka besar menghitung di panel kaca melayang, batangnya terisi cyan; orang bersorak, tangan ke atas

## proof

- en: a light pen draws a glowing bridge, glass floor tiles appear and tick themselves as the figure walks across
- id: pena cahaya menggambar jembatan bercahaya, ubin kaca muncul dan tercentang sendiri saat orang berjalan melewatinya

## offer

- en: a glass price card floats in, the price in heavy type, a red tag pops; the figure gives a thumbs-up
- id: kartu harga kaca melayang masuk, harga huruf tebal, label merah meletup; orang mengacungkan jempol

## cta

- en: name in heavy type and a red contact pill; the figure touches a glass panel and its lock opens; held 2 s
- id: nama huruf tebal dan pil kontak merah; orang menyentuh panel kaca dan gemboknya terbuka; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the figure walks toward a bright opening in the white studio, one closing line with a cyan word; held 2 s
- id: orang berjalan menuju bukaan terang di studio putih, satu kalimat penutup berkata cyan; diam 2 detik
